caption: The drawing depicts a golden-brown eagle with outstretched wings perched atop a light blue spherical object. The eagle's feathers are detailed, with shades of yellow and brown, and its head is turned slightly to the left. Its talons firmly grasp the top of the sphere. Encircling the base of the sphere is a twisted rope pattern in alternating white, blue, and red colors. The entire composition is mounted on a brown, polygonal wooden base. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, and there are no additional objects present in the image.
title: Eagle
